monastic mountain cartographer, 1970s, rendered as photoreal render concept art moodboard, warm amber highlights rolling into cool slate shadows, unglazed stoneware

You are the art director synthesising a single design lock for the character concept 'monastic mountain cartographer, 1970s, rendered as photoreal render'.

Using the brief and the attached moodboard image as tone reference only, fix: age, build, posture, face, hair, full costume layer by layer, at least four named materials with their wear state, palette with three named colours, and one signature prop.

Never copy a specific person or a copyrighted character from the moodboard — take palette, mood and material language only.

Grade target: a neutral commercial grade with clean whites and no colour cast. Lighting reference: hard low sun raking across the surface with long cast shadows.

Return the design lock as one dense paragraph, no headings, no commentary.

You are the character designer producing a turnaround sheet for the concept 'monastic mountain cartographer, 1970s, rendered as photoreal render'.

PANEL. This branch renders the three-quarter right: 45 degrees to camera-right, shoulders squared.

DESIGN LOCK. The upstream art-direction synthesis fixes silhouette, palette, material story, age, build and every signature prop. Restate those specifics in your prompt and change nothing — a turnaround only works if all panels describe the identical character.

PRESENTATION. Neutral flat backdrop, even paired strip-box rim lights raking both edges of the subject, no dramatic set dressing — the sheet exists to read construction, not mood. Keep the figure fully inside frame with consistent scale across panels.

MATERIALS. Specify at least four materials by name — cast pigmented resin, mirrored steel and others — with their wear state, and grade to a Portra-style palette with creamy skin tones and soft greens.

OUTPUT. Reply with a single continuous prompt paragraph. Never explain, never bullet, never wrap it in markdown fences.
